footer.privacy: Image, PDF and text tools stay in this tab. Clipboard notes are stored briefly on cv.cm, then deleted.

clip.a1: Yes. Paste text and get a link, with no account. Notes are only reachable by URL and are deleted after 10 views or 24 hours.
clip.q2: Do I need to sign up?
clip.a2: No. Create a note, copy the link, and send it. There is no login and no public listing.
clip.a3: After 10 views or 24 hours, whichever comes first. The last view tells you the note is gone.
clip.q4: Can I share images and files?
clip.a4: Yes. Text stays in D1 (up to 64 KB). Images, video, and other files go to S3, up to 32 MB each.
clip.a5: There is no directory. Only people with the link can open a note, and it still expires.

watermark.q1: Does adding a watermark upload my photos?
watermark.a1: No. ID copies and photos stay in this tab. The canvas stamps the mark here. Closing the tab discards the files. Export also strips EXIF.
watermark.q2: Can I watermark many photos at once?
watermark.a2: Yes. Add a batch, then download one file or a ZIP of PNG or JPEG.
watermark.q3: Can I watermark an ID or passport copy?
watermark.a3: Yes. Use For-use only so a tiled “for [org] use only” line covers the photo. Work stays in this tab. A watermark is a deterrent, not a legal guarantee. Some offices still want an unmarked copy.
watermark.a4: No. This tool only adds a mark. It will not erase watermarks from photos.
watermark.a5: PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF in. Export PNG, JPEG, or WebP. Text, a logo, or both.

collage.q1: Is this a photo collage maker?
collage.a1: Yes. Combine photos into one picture in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
collage.a2: Square, 4:5 portrait, 9:16 story, and 16:9 landscape are built in.
collage.q3: How many photos can I combine?
collage.a3: Layouts cover two to nine cells, including 2×2, 3×3, and split frames.
collage.a4: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, with quality control for the lossy formats.
collage.q5: Do my photos leave this device?
collage.a5: No. Processing stays in this tab. Closing the page discards them.

convert.q1: Can I convert HEIC to JPG?
convert.a1: Yes in browsers that can decode HEIC (Safari, and Chromium with support). Then download a JPG.
convert.q2: Can I convert WebP to PNG or JPG to PNG?
convert.a2: Yes. Shortcuts cover HEIC → JPG, WebP → PNG, PNG ↔ JPG, SVG → PNG, and ICO.
convert.q3: Are images uploaded to a server?
convert.a3: No. Conversion uses the canvas in this tab.
convert.q4: Can I convert several images at once?
convert.a4: Yes. Download one file or a ZIP of the whole batch.
convert.a5: Yes. Keep the original size or cap the longest side at 2048, 1920, 1280, or 800 pixels.

image-pdf.q1: Can I convert JPG to PDF or PNG to PDF?
image-pdf.a1: Yes. Drop JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or HEIC photos and download one PDF.
image-pdf.q2: Can several photos become one PDF?
image-pdf.a2: Yes. Reorder the pages, then download a single file.
image-pdf.a3: A4, US Letter, or a page that matches the photo’s aspect ratio.
image-pdf.a4: No. Each image is fitted onto its page without cropping.
image-pdf.a5: No. The PDF is built in this tab.

audio.q1: Can I convert MP3 to WAV?
audio.a1: Yes. M4A, OGG, AAC, FLAC, and WebM also decode to WAV in the browser.
audio.a2: No. Web Audio decodes the file in this tab.
audio.q3: Can I choose the sample rate?
audio.a3: Keep the original rate, or export 44.1 kHz or 48 kHz.
audio.a4: Yes. Download one WAV or a ZIP of the batch.
audio.a5: Not yet. This tool writes WAV so the output stays uncompressed and on-device.

data.a1: Yes. Pretty-print or minify JSON in this tab. Conversion runs as you type.
data.q2: Can I convert CSV to JSON?
data.a2: Both directions: CSV → JSON and JSON → CSV.
data.q3: Does it encode Base64 and URLs?
data.a3: Yes. Encode or decode Base64 and URL components, including Unicode text.
data.q4: Can I turn Markdown into HTML?
data.a4: Yes, and HTML back into Markdown. Copy or download the result.
data.a5: No. You can also open a local file; it never leaves this tab.

qr.q1: Is this a QR code generator?
qr.a1: Yes. Type a URL or any text and download a PNG. Encoding runs in this tab.
qr.a2: No. The code is drawn on a canvas in your browser.
qr.a3: Higher levels (Q, H) survive more damage or logos on the code, but need a larger QR.
qr.a4: Yes. Pick foreground and background colors before downloading.
qr.a5: Short URLs fit a small code. A few hundred characters still work; very long notes will be rejected.

password.a1: Yes. It builds a random password with Web Crypto in this tab.
password.a2: No. Generating and copying stay on your device. Closing the tab discards them.
password.a3: Entropy is length × log2(charset). 16 mixed characters is typically 80+ bits.
password.a4: Yes. Toggle lowercase, uppercase, digits, and symbols. You can also skip look-alike characters.
password.a5: No. It uses crypto.getRandomValues with unbiased sampling.

word-count.a1: Yes. It counts words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, lines, and a 200 wpm reading time.
word-count.q2: How are Chinese or Japanese words counted?
word-count.a2: Each CJK character counts as one word. Latin text still splits on spaces.
word-count.a3: No. Counting is local. You can also open a text file from your device.
word-count.a4: Characters includes spaces. There is a separate count without whitespace.
word-count.a5: About 200 words per minute, rounded up to a whole minute.

resize.a1: Yes. Set exact width and height, or cap the longest side at 1920, 1280, or 800 pixels.
resize.a2: Yes. Export JPG or WebP and drag the quality slider. The estimated file size updates as you edit.
resize.a3: No. Decoding and encoding use the canvas in this tab.
resize.q4: Does it keep the aspect ratio?
resize.a4: On by default. Uncheck it to stretch to any width and height.
resize.a5: JPG, WebP, or PNG. HEIC and AVIF can be opened when the browser can decode them.

crop.a1: Yes. Drop a photo, drag the frame, then download the cropped image.
crop.a2: 1:1, 4:5, 9:16 story, and 16:9, plus a free rectangle.
crop.a3: No. Cropping is local to this tab.
crop.q4: Can I paste from the clipboard?
crop.a4: Yes. Ctrl/⌘ V pastes an image, same as the other image tools.
crop.a5: JPG, PNG, or WebP of just the selected region.

color.a1: Yes. Pick a color and copy hex, RGB, or HSL. Everything stays in this tab.
color.a2: In Chromium browsers the EyeDropper API can sample any pixel on screen. Other browsers still have the native picker.
color.q3: Can I type a hex code?
color.a3: Yes. Hex, rgb(), and hsl() all parse. Invalid input is ignored.
color.a4: WCAG contrast against white and black. 4.5:1 is the usual body-text floor.
color.q5: Is the color sent to a server?
color.a5: No. There is no network call.

pdf-jpg.q1: Can I convert a PDF to JPG?
pdf-jpg.a1: Yes. Each page is drawn in this tab and saved as JPG, PNG, or WebP.
pdf-jpg.a2: Yes. One page downloads as an image. Several pages download as a ZIP.
pdf-jpg.a3: No. pdf.js renders it locally. Closing the tab discards it.
pdf-jpg.a4: It paints a larger bitmap, sharper but heavier. Use 1× for small files.
pdf-jpg.a5: Yes. Image-only pages export as pictures. Text-only pages are rasterized too.

merge-pdf.a1: Yes. Combine two or more PDFs, reorder them, and download one file.
merge-pdf.a2: No. Merging uses pdf-lib in this tab.
merge-pdf.a3: Yes. Use the arrows in the file list before downloading.
merge-pdf.a4: Encrypted PDFs often cannot be merged here. Unlock them first.
merge-pdf.a5: Pages are copied. Bookmarks and forms may be dropped.

make-qr.q1: Can I make a QR code for free online?
make-qr.a1: Yes. The generator on cv.cm runs in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
make-qr.a2: No. A current phone camera reads the PNG. You only need the generator to create it.
make-qr.q3: Can I make a Wi-Fi QR code?
make-qr.a3: You can encode the network name as text. Guests still type the password unless you use a WIFI: payload your camera understands.
make-qr.q4: Why does it open a search instead of my site?
make-qr.a4: The URL is missing https:// or has a space. Paste the address from the browser bar and scan again.
make-qr.q5: How large should I print it?
make-qr.a5: At least 2 cm wide on paper, with a white margin. Scan the print. If it fails, print larger, do not stretch.

make-barcode.q1: Is a barcode the same as a QR code?
make-barcode.a1: No. A 1D barcode identifies an item. A QR code usually opens a URL. Use the reader you have at the counter.
make-barcode.q2: Can I make a barcode free online?
make-barcode.a2: Yes. cv.cm runs in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
make-barcode.a3: Twelve digits you type, plus a check digit the tool adds.
make-barcode.q4: Why does my phone read it but the shop scanner does not?
make-barcode.a4: The gun may only accept EAN-13 or Code 39. Switch symbology and print again. Test on that gun.
make-barcode.q5: Can I use any numbers for a product barcode?
make-barcode.a5: No. Retail GTINs are allocated. Internal Code 128 IDs are yours to assign.

merge-pdf.q1: Can I merge PDF files free online?
merge-pdf.a1: Yes. cv.cm merges in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
merge-pdf.q2: How do I combine PDF files in order?
merge-pdf.a2: Drop them in order, or drag rows. The first row is page 1.
merge-pdf.q3: Why is a file missing after merge?
merge-pdf.a3: It was probably password-locked or damaged. Unlock it and add it again.
merge-pdf.a4: No. This page merges in the browser.
merge-pdf.a5: No. Closing the tab discards the list.

compress-pdf.q1: How do I reduce PDF file size without Adobe?
compress-pdf.a1: Re-encode pages in this tab, then open a photo page to check.
compress-pdf.q2: Why is my compressed PDF blurry?
compress-pdf.a2: Photos were re-encoded too hard. Use milder compression or split the PDF.
compress-pdf.a3: No. Closing the tab discards the result.
compress-pdf.q4: What size should I aim for?
compress-pdf.a4: The field you will upload to. Email is often 10–25 MB. Some forms want 2 MB.
compress-pdf.q5: Can I compress without losing text?
compress-pdf.a5: Usually yes. Check a table of digits at 100% after export.

heic-to-jpg.q1: How do I convert HEIC to JPG on Windows?
heic-to-jpg.a1: Use Chrome or Edge on that PC, or convert on a Mac/iPhone first and send the JPG.
heic-to-jpg.a2: This browser cannot decode HEIC. Switch to Safari or Chrome. Firefox on Windows often fails.
heic-to-jpg.a3: No. Conversion stays in this tab.
heic-to-jpg.q4: Does converting make the photo sharper?
heic-to-jpg.a4: No. It only changes compatibility. Keep the HEIC if you still edit on iPhone.
heic-to-jpg.q5: Can I convert several HEIC files at once?
heic-to-jpg.a5: Yes. Drop a batch and download a ZIP of JPGs.

jpg-to-pdf.q1: How do I convert JPG to PDF for free?
jpg-to-pdf.a1: Drop the photos on cv.cm in this tab and download one PDF. Nothing is uploaded.
jpg-to-pdf.q2: Can I convert several images into one PDF?
jpg-to-pdf.a2: Yes. List order is page order. Reorder before you download.
jpg-to-pdf.a3: A4/Letter for printers and forms. Fit-to-photo for a full-bleed lookbook.
jpg-to-pdf.a4: It failed to decode — often HEIC in Firefox. Convert that file to JPG and add it.
jpg-to-pdf.a5: No. Closing the tab discards the list.

pdf-to-jpg.q1: How do I convert PDF to JPG free online?
pdf-to-jpg.a1: Drop the PDF on cv.cm in this tab. Download a page or a ZIP. Nothing is uploaded.
pdf-to-jpg.a2: JPG for photos. PNG if a table of digits must stay crisp.
pdf-to-jpg.a3: Raise the scale to 2×. Check at 100%, not the thumbnail.
pdf-to-jpg.q4: Can I convert all pages at once?
pdf-to-jpg.a4: Yes. Download a ZIP of every page.
pdf-to-jpg.a5: No. Closing the tab discards the render.

crop-photo.q1: How do I crop a photo on iPhone without the Photos app?
crop-photo.a1: AirDrop or Files the image to a browser tab on cv.cm crop, or convert HEIC to JPG first if the preview is blank.
crop-photo.a2: Feed often shows 4:5 portrait. Avatars are 1:1. Stories are 9:16. Lock the ratio before you drag.
crop-photo.a3: No. Closing the tab discards the crop.
crop-photo.q4: Should I crop on the phone first?
crop-photo.a4: You can. If you need a precise 4:5 for a desktop post, crop here and keep the original on the phone.
crop-photo.q5: Why does a second crop look worse?
crop-photo.a5: You cropped a crop. Go back to the original file.

webp-to-png.q1: Can I convert WebP to PNG free online?
webp-to-png.a1: Yes. cv.cm converts in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
webp-to-png.q2: Why did Chrome save a WebP?
webp-to-png.a2: Many sites serve WebP because it is smaller. Save as PNG here when the destination rejects WebP.
webp-to-png.a3: Yes if you export PNG. JPG will fill the background.
webp-to-png.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
webp-to-png.q5: Can I convert WebP to JPG instead?
webp-to-png.a5: Yes. Pick JPG if you want a smaller photo and do not need transparency.

resize-image.q1: How do I resize an image without Photoshop?
resize-image.a1: Drop the photo on cv.cm resize in this tab. Set pixels, download. Nothing is uploaded.
resize-image.q2: How do I compress a JPG for email?
resize-image.a2: Export JPEG and lower quality until it is under the cap. Then open a real pixel at 100%.
resize-image.q3: Should I unlock the aspect ratio?
resize-image.a3: No, unless you mean to stretch. Stretching looks wrong on faces and logos.
resize-image.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
resize-image.q5: Can I resize several photos at once?
resize-image.a5: This lesson covers one photo. Convert or watermark can batch; come back per file if you need exact pixels.

split-pdf.q1: How do I split a PDF without Adobe?
split-pdf.a1: Drop it on cv.cm split in this tab. Choose each page or a range. Nothing is uploaded.
split-pdf.q2: Can I extract just pages 1 to 3?
split-pdf.a2: Yes. Type 1-3 and download one PDF with those pages.
split-pdf.a3: Encrypted files often cannot split here. Unlock them first.
split-pdf.a4: No. Splitting uses pdf-lib in this tab.
split-pdf.a5: Pages are copied. Bookmarks and forms may be dropped.

add-watermark.q1: How do I add a watermark without Photoshop?
add-watermark.a1: Drop photos on cv.cm watermark in this tab. Type text or a logo, download. Nothing is uploaded.
add-watermark.q2: Can I watermark a batch of shop photos?
add-watermark.a2: Yes. Drop several, set one mark, download a ZIP.
add-watermark.a3: No. This lesson only adds a mark. Removing someone else's mark is a different, often unwelcome, job.
add-watermark.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
add-watermark.q5: Should I tile or use a corner?
add-watermark.a5: Tile if someone might crop the corner. A single corner is quieter on a portrait.

remove-exif.q1: How do I remove GPS from an iPhone photo?
remove-exif.a1: Drop it on cv.cm EXIF in this tab, export, then drop the export to confirm. Keep the original if you still want the pin.
remove-exif.a2: Some chats compress and strip. Public listings and email attachments often do not. Prove it with a second drop.
remove-exif.a3: No. Closing the tab discards them.
remove-exif.a4: No. You download a new file. Keep or delete the original yourself.
remove-exif.a5: They often have no GPS. Drop one in; if it is already clean, you are done.

make-collage.q1: Can I make a photo collage free online?
make-collage.a1: Yes. cv.cm runs in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
make-collage.q2: How do I make a 2×2 Instagram collage?
make-collage.a2: Pick 2×2 and square (or 4:5). Drop four photos, check Contain vs Cover, download.
make-collage.q3: Why did a face get cropped?
make-collage.a3: Cover fills the cell. Switch to Contain, or pick a photo with more room around the head.
make-collage.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
make-collage.q5: Can I collage without Canva or Photoshop?
make-collage.a5: Yes. This page is the collage. No account.

make-meme.q1: Can I make a meme free online?
make-meme.a1: Yes. cv.cm draws in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
make-meme.q2: Do I need Photoshop or an app?
make-meme.a2: No. A current browser is enough.
make-meme.q3: What font should a meme use?
make-meme.a3: Heavy sans with a dark stroke, usually all caps. This tool uses that look.
make-meme.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
make-meme.q5: Can I make a meme on iPhone?
make-meme.a5: Yes in Safari. If a HEIC will not preview, convert it to JPG first.

count-words.q1: How do I count words online?
count-words.a1: Paste into cv.cm word count in this tab. Read Words. Nothing is uploaded.
count-words.q2: What is the difference between words and characters?
count-words.a2: Words split on spaces (and each CJK character counts as a word here). Characters count every letter, space, and punctuation.
count-words.q3: How do I count Chinese characters?
count-words.a3: Use characters with no spaces if the teacher wants 字数. Do not use Words for an 800-字 paper.
count-words.a4: No. Closing the tab discards it.
count-words.q5: Why doesn't it match Microsoft Word?
count-words.a5: Each app splits words differently, especially with CJK, hyphens, and numbers. Count in the same tool as the cap.

trim-audio.q1: How do I cut an MP3 online for free?
trim-audio.a1: Drop it on cv.cm audio cutter in this tab, mark start and end, listen, download WAV. Nothing is uploaded.
trim-audio.q2: Why is the download WAV, not MP3?
trim-audio.a2: The cutter re-encodes the selection as WAV in the browser. If you need MP3, convert the WAV afterwards.
trim-audio.q3: Can I trim M4A or voice memos?
trim-audio.a3: If the browser can decode the file, yes. If playback fails, export WAV from the recorder first.
trim-audio.a4: No. Closing the tab discards it.
trim-audio.q5: Will this change the original file?
trim-audio.a5: No. You download a new WAV. The MP3 on disk stays.

png-to-jpg.q1: Can I convert PNG to JPG free online?
png-to-jpg.a1: Yes. cv.cm converts in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
png-to-jpg.a2: No. JPG has no alpha. The clear area becomes a solid matte, often black. Keep PNG for stickers and logos.
png-to-jpg.a3: No. Closing the tab discards them.
png-to-jpg.a4: Start near 0.9. If the file is still over the cap, lower quality or cap the long edge. Open at 100% before you send.
png-to-jpg.q5: Can I convert PNG to JPG without Photoshop?
png-to-jpg.a5: Yes. This page is the converter. No account.

jpg-to-png.q1: Can I convert JPG to PNG free online?
jpg-to-png.a1: Yes. cv.cm converts in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
jpg-to-png.q2: Will JPG to PNG make the background transparent?
jpg-to-png.a2: No. A JPG has no alpha. The PNG stays opaque. You would need a separate cutout.
jpg-to-png.a3: PNG is lossless. It stores the pixels without JPEG compression, so photos often grow.
jpg-to-png.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
jpg-to-png.q5: Can I convert JPG to PNG without Photoshop?
jpg-to-png.a5: Yes. This page is the converter. No account.

avif-to-jpg.q1: Can I convert AVIF to JPG free online?
avif-to-jpg.a1: Yes. cv.cm converts in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
avif-to-jpg.q2: Why did Chrome save an AVIF?
avif-to-jpg.a2: Many sites serve AVIF because it is smaller than JPG. Save as JPG here when the destination rejects AVIF.
avif-to-jpg.a3: This browser cannot decode AVIF. Switch to current Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
avif-to-jpg.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
avif-to-jpg.q5: Can I convert several AVIF files at once?
avif-to-jpg.a5: Yes. Drop a batch and download each JPG, or a ZIP if the tool offers one.

rotate-photo.q1: Can I rotate a photo free online?
rotate-photo.a1: Yes. cv.cm rotates in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
rotate-photo.q2: What is the difference between rotate and flip?
rotate-photo.a2: Rotate turns the whole photo. Flip mirrors it. Use 90° for a sideways phone shot; use flip if letters read backward.
rotate-photo.q3: Why does Windows still show my iPhone photo sideways?
rotate-photo.a3: The original may only store rotation in EXIF. Export from this tab writes the pixels upright. Open the download, not the original.
rotate-photo.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
rotate-photo.a5: Yes. This page is the rotator. No account.

png-to-webp.q1: Can I convert PNG to WebP free online?
png-to-webp.a1: Yes. cv.cm converts in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
png-to-webp.a2: Yes if you export WebP. JPG will fill the background. Keep PNG if a form rejects WebP.
png-to-webp.a3: No. Closing the tab discards them.
png-to-webp.q4: WebP or JPG for a smaller photo?
png-to-webp.a4: WebP if you need transparency or a web page. JPG if email or a form that rejects WebP.
png-to-webp.q5: Can I convert PNG to WebP without Photoshop?
png-to-webp.a5: Yes. This page is the converter. No account.

mp3-to-wav.q1: Can I convert MP3 to WAV free online?
mp3-to-wav.a1: Yes. cv.cm decodes in this tab and downloads WAV. Nothing is uploaded.
mp3-to-wav.q2: Will converting MP3 to WAV improve quality?
mp3-to-wav.a2: No. WAV only stores what is left after MP3 compression. The file gets larger.
mp3-to-wav.a3: 44.1 for music and CD-style work. 48 for video. Leave original if you are unsure.
mp3-to-wav.a4: No. Closing the tab discards it.
mp3-to-wav.q5: Can I convert M4A or voice memos?
mp3-to-wav.a5: If the browser can decode the file, yes. Output is still WAV.

join-audio.q1: Can I merge MP3 files free online?
join-audio.a1: Yes. Drop two or more on cv.cm audio joiner in this tab, reorder, download WAV. Nothing is uploaded.
join-audio.q2: Why is the download WAV, not MP3?
join-audio.a2: The joiner concatenates decoded PCM and writes WAV in the browser. If you need MP3, convert the WAV afterwards.
join-audio.a3: Yes. One clip is not a join. Add a second file or go to trim if you only need a slice.
join-audio.a4: No. Closing the tab discards it.
join-audio.q5: Will this change the original files?
join-audio.a5: No. You download a new WAV. The MP3s on disk stay.

make-favicon.q1: Can I make a favicon free online?
make-favicon.a1: Yes. cv.cm draws in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
make-favicon.q2: What sizes are in the ICO?
make-favicon.a2: 16, 32, and 48 pixel PNG images packed into one favicon.ico.
make-favicon.q3: Do I need Apple touch icons too?
make-favicon.a3: The PNG zip includes 180, 192, and 512. Link those in HTML for home-screen icons.
make-favicon.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
make-favicon.q5: Can I keep a transparent background?
make-favicon.a5: Yes. Uncheck white background. Contain then letterboxes on transparency.

make-signature.q1: Can I draw a signature free online?
make-signature.a1: Yes. cv.cm draws in this tab. Nothing is uploaded. It is not a legal e-sign.
make-signature.q2: Is this a legally binding e-signature?
make-signature.a2: No. You get a PNG of ink. Banks and governments usually want a qualified e-sign or a wet signature.
make-signature.a3: No. Download a PNG and paste it only where a form asks for an image.
make-signature.a4: No. Closing the tab discards it.
make-signature.a5: Export keeps the ink and drops empty pad. The background is transparent so it sits on a form.

annotate-screenshot.q1: Can I annotate a screenshot free online?
annotate-screenshot.a1: Yes. cv.cm draws in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
annotate-screenshot.a2: A rectangle, an arrow, or a short text label. Undo removes the last mark.
annotate-screenshot.a3: No. Closing the tab discards it.
annotate-screenshot.q4: Does this change the original file?
annotate-screenshot.a4: No. You download a new PNG. The capture on disk stays unmarked.
annotate-screenshot.q5: Can I paste from the clipboard?
annotate-screenshot.a5: Yes, if the capture is an image. Then mark and download PNG.

make-invoice.q1: Can I make an invoice PDF free online?
make-invoice.a1: Yes. cv.cm draws in this tab and downloads a PDF. Nothing is uploaded.
make-invoice.q2: Is this a tax form or a legal e-invoice?
make-invoice.a2: No. It is a simple one-page bill. It does not file VAT and it is not a qualified e-invoice.
make-invoice.a3: A percent of the subtotal (qty × price for every line). Use 0 if the sale is untaxed here.
make-invoice.a4: No. Closing the tab discards them.
make-invoice.a5: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY, KRW, VND, and IDR. Pick the one the buyer will pay.

make-password.q1: Can I generate a strong password free online?
make-password.a1: Yes. cv.cm uses Web Crypto in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
make-password.q2: How long should a password be?
make-password.a2: 16 or more if the site allows it. Default here is 16. Below 12 is only for sites that still cap length.
make-password.a3: It drops 0, O, I, l, and 1 so the string is easier to read if you must type it.
make-password.a4: No. Closing the tab discards it.
make-password.q5: Should I email the password to myself?
make-password.a5: No. Paste into the account, store it in a password manager, close the tab.

format-json.q1: Can I format JSON free online?
format-json.a1: Yes. cv.cm pretty-prints or minifies in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
format-json.a2: Comments, a comma after the last item, and single quotes are not JSON. Strip a log prefix before the first brace.
format-json.q3: What is the difference between pretty and minify?
format-json.a3: Pretty indents with two spaces. Minify is one line. The values stay the same when the text parsed.
format-json.a4: An integer longer than 15 digits can change unless it is a string in quotes.
format-json.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

decode-base64.q1: Can I decode Base64 free online?
decode-base64.a1: Yes. cv.cm encodes and decodes in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
decode-base64.a2: Minus and underscore are refused. The length must be a multiple of 4. Padding is =. Remove a data: prefix, and the payload must be text.
decode-base64.a3: No. This page prints UTF-8 text. A PNG or a PDF is bytes, so decode fails on purpose.
decode-base64.a4: Yes. Letters outside ASCII become their UTF-8 bytes, then standard Base64.
decode-base64.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

unix-time.q1: Can I convert a Unix timestamp free online?
unix-time.a1: Yes. cv.cm converts in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
unix-time.q2: How do you tell seconds from milliseconds?
unix-time.a2: Ten digits are seconds. Thirteen are milliseconds. Sixteen are microseconds and are divided by 1,000 once.
unix-time.q3: What if the year is wrong?
unix-time.a3: You converted twice, or the digit count was wrong. Paste the original number. Leave a 13-digit value as it is.
unix-time.a4: Yes. An ISO date such as 2023-11-14T22:13:20Z works. Now fills the current Unix second.
unix-time.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

read-jwt.q1: Can I decode a JWT free online?
read-jwt.a1: Yes. cv.cm reads the header and payload in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
read-jwt.a2: No. You get JSON you can read. The signature, the issuer, and the audience stay unchecked.
read-jwt.a3: The exp claim, in seconds, is before now. It is a clock compare. Missing exp means there is no expiry claim. Neither case checks the signature.
read-jwt.a4: The value needs two or three parts separated by dots, and the header and payload must be base64url JSON.
read-jwt.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. Keep a live access token off chat and off a shared screen.

count-workdays.q1: Can I count business days free online?
count-workdays.a1: Yes. cv.cm counts Monday through Friday in this tab, including both dates. Nothing is uploaded.
count-workdays.a2: No. Only Saturdays and Sundays are left out. Subtract a Wednesday holiday yourself if the form requires it.
count-workdays.q3: Does the count include both dates?
count-workdays.a3: Yes. A weekday that is both the start and the end counts as 1. A Saturday or Sunday that is both counts as 0.
count-workdays.q4: What if the end is before the start?
count-workdays.a4: The business-day number is negative. The weekend count stays zero or positive.
count-workdays.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

simplify-fraction.q1: Can I simplify a fraction free online?
simplify-fraction.a1: Yes. cv.cm reduces whole numbers or a decimal in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
simplify-fraction.a2: 2/3. The sign stays on the numerator. A negative denominator flips.
simplify-fraction.q3: Can I start from a decimal?
simplify-fraction.a3: Yes. 0.75 becomes 3/4. The denominator stops at 10,000, so a long decimal may be close rather than exact.
simplify-fraction.q4: Will I get a mixed number?
simplify-fraction.a4: No. 5/2 stays 5/2. Split the whole part yourself if a worksheet wants 2 1/2.
simplify-fraction.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

hourly-pay.q1: Can I convert hourly pay to a yearly salary free online?
hourly-pay.a1: Yes. cv.cm multiplies or divides in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
hourly-pay.a2: 40 hours a week and 52 weeks a year, which is 2,080 hours. 20 an hour is then 41,600.00 gross.
hourly-pay.a3: No. The three lines are gross. Subtract tax, insurance, and pension on the form that asks for net pay.
hourly-pay.q4: What if I have unpaid weeks or overtime?
hourly-pay.a4: Lower the weeks for unpaid time. Overtime at a higher rate is a second calculation. This page uses one rate, and weeks cannot pass 52.
hourly-pay.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

convert-timezone.q1: Can I convert a time zone free online?
convert-timezone.a1: Yes. cv.cm converts a wall time between two IANA zones in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
convert-timezone.a2: Yes. New York in January is UTC−05:00. In July it is UTC−04:00. The offset follows the date you picked.
convert-timezone.a3: The zone that owns the clock you were given. A New York 9:00 stays America/New_York even if you are somewhere else.
convert-timezone.q4: What does copy put on the clipboard?
convert-timezone.a4: The ISO time of that instant in UTC. The wall-clock line stays on the page.
convert-timezone.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

profit-margin.q1: Can I calculate a profit margin free online?
profit-margin.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows profit, margin, and markup in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
profit-margin.q2: What is the difference between margin and markup?
profit-margin.a2: Margin is profit divided by the selling price. Markup is profit divided by the cost. Cost 50 and price 80 is 37.50% margin and 60.00% markup.
profit-margin.q3: What if the price is below the cost?
profit-margin.a3: Profit, margin, and markup are negative.
profit-margin.q4: What if the price or the cost is zero?
profit-margin.a4: A zero price has no margin percent. A zero cost has no markup percent. Both zero fails.
profit-margin.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

convert-base.q1: Can I convert between bases free online?
convert-base.a1: Yes. cv.cm converts one integer between bases 2 and 36 in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
convert-base.a2: FF. From base 10 to base 16. The letters are uppercase.
convert-base.q3: Can I type 0x or a decimal point?
convert-base.a3: No. Type the digits only. A fraction is not an integer in a base.
convert-base.q4: Is this the tool that turns text into binary?
convert-base.a4: No. This converts one integer. The binary tool turns letters into 8-bit groups.
convert-base.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

add-duration.q1: Can I add hours and minutes free online?
add-duration.a1: Yes. cv.cm adds or subtracts two H:MM:SS lengths in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
add-duration.q2: What format do the times use?
add-duration.a2: Hours:minutes:seconds, such as 1:30:00. Minutes and seconds must be 0–59. 0:90:00 fails. Write 1:30:00.
add-duration.q4: What if the second time is longer?
add-duration.a4: Subtracting it gives a negative length, such as -0:15:00. That is a direction, not a clock time.
add-duration.q5: Is this a time zone converter?
add-duration.a5: No. These are lengths of time. A clock time in a city is the time-zone tool.

calculate-percent.q1: Can I calculate a percentage free online?
calculate-percent.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows four readings of the same two numbers in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-percent.a2: 50. That is the first line when the boxes are 25 and 200.
calculate-percent.a3: 12.5%. That is the second line, not the first.
calculate-percent.a4: 250. That is the third line. The change from 200 down to 25 is -87.5%, which is the fourth line.
calculate-percent.q5: What if the second number is zero?
calculate-percent.a5: What-percent and percent-change become a dash. You cannot divide by zero. The other two lines still run.

days-between.q1: Can I count days between two dates free online?
days-between.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the signed days, the absolute days, and whole weeks in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
days-between.q2: Does the count include both dates?
days-between.a2: No. The same day is 0. Monday 5 January 2026 to Friday 9 January is 4. A form that includes both dates wants 5.
days-between.a3: No. Weekends stay in this count. The business-day page skips Saturday and Sunday and includes both ends.
days-between.a4: Yes, when the leap day sits in the gap. 28 February 2024 to 1 March 2024 is 2 days.
days-between.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

shift-date.q1: Can I add days to a date free online?
shift-date.a1: Yes. cv.cm shifts a civil date by a whole number of days in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
shift-date.q2: Can the number be negative or a fraction?
shift-date.a2: Negative numbers go backward. 1.5 is rejected. Only a whole number of days works.
shift-date.a3: 29 February 2024. In 2023 the same step lands on 1 March.
shift-date.q4: Does Friday plus 1 skip the weekend?
shift-date.a4: No. Friday plus 1 is Saturday. Add 3 to land on Monday.
shift-date.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

iso-week.q1: Can I find an ISO week number free online?
iso-week.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the ISO year, week, and weekday in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
iso-week.a2: Monday. Monday is 1 and Sunday is 7. A Sunday-start week is a different number.
iso-week.q3: Can January belong to the previous year?
iso-week.a3: Yes. 1 January 2021 is a Friday in 2020-W53. Week 1 is the week with the first Thursday.
iso-week.q4: Can late December belong to the next year?
iso-week.a4: Yes. 30 December 2024 is a Monday in 2025-W01.
iso-week.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

vat-price.q1: Can I add VAT to a price free online?
vat-price.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows net, tax, and gross in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
vat-price.a3: Net 100.00, tax 20.00, gross 120.00. The tax is not 24.00.
vat-price.q4: Does the page look up a country rate?
vat-price.a4: No. You type the rate. The three lines are arithmetic, not a tax filing, and they do not name a currency.
vat-price.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

percent-off.q1: Can I calculate a discount free online?
percent-off.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the sale price and the saving in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
percent-off.a2: Sale price 80.00, saving 20.00. That is not a 20% profit margin.
percent-off.a3: Yes. 120% off 100 is a sale price of -20.00. That is arithmetic, not a shop rule.
percent-off.q4: What does a negative percent do?
percent-off.a4: It raises the price. Minus 10% on 100 is 110.00. A tag that says 10% off uses 10.
percent-off.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. The numbers have no currency.

encode-url.q1: Can I encode a URL free online?
encode-url.a1: Yes. cv.cm encodes and decodes the string in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
encode-url.a2: Encode writes %20. Decode turns %20 and + into a space.
encode-url.q3: Will slashes stay if I encode a whole address?
encode-url.a3: No. : and / become %3A and %2F. Encode a query value when the address itself must stay openable.
encode-url.a4: A % needs two hex digits after it. %zz and a lone % fail.
encode-url.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

calculate-age.q1: Can I calculate age free online?
calculate-age.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows years, months, days, and total days in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-age.q2: Does the year increase before the birthday?
calculate-age.a2: No. Born 15 March 2000, on 14 March 2026 the age is still 25 years, 11 months, and 27 days.
calculate-age.q3: What if the later date is before the birth date?
calculate-age.a3: The page fails. Age counts forward from the birth date.
calculate-age.q4: Is 29 February a real birth date?
calculate-age.a4: Yes. On 28 February 2025, a 29 February 2000 birth is 24 years, 11 months, and 30 days.
calculate-age.a5: No. Closing the tab discards them.

aspect-ratio.q1: Can I find an aspect ratio free online?
aspect-ratio.a1: Yes. cv.cm reduces width and height in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
aspect-ratio.a3: No. It only reduces the two numbers. The picture stays the size you typed.
aspect-ratio.a4: Each side is rounded to a whole pixel before the ratio.
aspect-ratio.a5: No. Closing the tab discards them.

calculate-bmi.q1: Can I calculate BMI free online?
calculate-bmi.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the BMI and the band in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-bmi.q2: What is the BMI for 70 kg and 170 cm?
calculate-bmi.q3: What if I type 1.70 for the height?
calculate-bmi.a3: The box is centimetres, so 1.70 means 1.70 cm. The BMI becomes 242214.5. Type 170.
calculate-bmi.a4: At 25. 18.5 is still Normal. Obesity starts at 30.
calculate-bmi.a5: No. Closing the tab discards them. The band is not a diagnosis.

split-tip.q1: Can I split a tip free online?
split-tip.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the tip, the total, and each share in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
split-tip.q2: What does each person pay on 100 at 20% for 4 people?
split-tip.a2: 30.00. The tip is 20.00 and the total is 120.00. 5.00 would be the tip split alone.
split-tip.a3: It counts as 2. The fraction is dropped. On 100 at 20%, each of those 2 pays 60.00.
split-tip.q4: What if the people count is below 1?
split-tip.a4: The page fails. 0.9 is not rounded up to 1.
split-tip.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. The numbers have no currency.

loan-payment.q1: Can I calculate a loan payment free online?
loan-payment.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the monthly payment, the interest, and the total in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
loan-payment.q2: What is the payment on 10000 at 12% for one year?
loan-payment.a2: 888.49 a month. Interest is 661.85 and the total is 10661.85. It is not 1200 of interest.
loan-payment.q3: What does a zero interest rate do?
loan-payment.a3: It divides the principal by the number of months. 12000 for one year is 1000.00 a month and 0.00 interest.
loan-payment.q4: Does 12 in the rate box mean 0.12?
loan-payment.a4: No. 12 means 12% a year. The monthly rate is that percent divided by 12. One year is 12 payments, not one.
loan-payment.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. The page does not name a lender or a currency.

read-cron.q1: Can I read a cron expression free online?
read-cron.a1: Yes. cv.cm describes the five fields in this tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the job is not started.
read-cron.a2: Minute 0, hour 9, every day of the month, every month, and Monday.
read-cron.a3: 0 and 7. Monday is 1. The word MON fails.
read-cron.q4: Why did a six-field expression fail?
read-cron.a4: This page wants exactly five fields. There is no seconds field. Minute 60 also fails, because minutes stop at 59.
read-cron.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. The page does not run the schedule.

compress-pdf.q1: Can I compress a PDF here?
compress-pdf.a1: Yes. This PDF compressor redraws each page as JPEG and packs a new PDF in this tab.
compress-pdf.a2: No. pdf.js renders locally. Closing the tab discards it.
compress-pdf.q3: Will the file always get smaller?
compress-pdf.a3: Usually for scans and photo PDFs. An already-tiny text PDF may not shrink much.
compress-pdf.a4: No. Pages become images, so text is no longer selectable.
compress-pdf.q5: What do quality and resolution do?
compress-pdf.a5: Quality is JPEG compression. 1× is smaller; 2× is sharper and heavier.

split-pdf.q1: Can I split a PDF into pages?
split-pdf.a1: Yes. Each page becomes its own PDF, packed in a ZIP when there are several.
split-pdf.q2: Can I keep only some pages?
split-pdf.a2: Yes. Use a range like 1-3,5 and download one PDF with those pages.
split-pdf.a3: No. pdf-lib runs in this tab.
split-pdf.a4: Often not. Unlock the file first.
split-pdf.a5: Pages are copied. Bookmarks and forms may be dropped.

names.a1: Yes. It makes random given+family names or usernames in this tab.
names.a2: No. They are random combinations for mockups, games, or handles — not legal identities.
names.a3: Yes. Switch to username for adjective+noun handles, sometimes with digits.
names.a4: No. Generation uses Web Crypto locally.
names.q5: Can I copy the whole list?
names.a5: Yes. Copy list puts every line on the clipboard.

timezone.q1: How do I convert a time zone?
timezone.a1: Pick the source zone, the destination zone, and a date-time. The result is the same instant shown on the other clock.
timezone.a2: Yes. Conversion uses IANA zones, so New York switches between EST and EDT automatically.
timezone.a3: No. Intl.DateTimeFormat runs in this tab. Closing it discards the conversion.
timezone.a4: It is the same instant as ISO-8601 in UTC, useful for APIs, logs, and calendars.
timezone.a5: Common cities first, then every IANA zone the browser knows, including UTC.

lorem.q1: What is a lorem ipsum generator?
lorem.a1: It fills a layout with classic Latin-like placeholder text so you can judge spacing before the real copy is ready.
lorem.q2: Can I choose paragraphs or words?
lorem.a2: Yes. Switch among paragraphs, sentences, and words, then drag the count slider.
lorem.a3: It follows the usual dummy-text word list. It is not a translation of a real passage.
lorem.a4: No. The text is built from a local word list in this tab.
lorem.a5: Yes. Copy puts the whole block on the clipboard so you can paste it into a mockup.

units.a1: Choose a category, a from-unit and a to-unit, then type a number. The result updates in this tab.
units.q2: Can I convert cm to inches?
units.a2: Yes. Length includes mm, cm, m, km, inches, feet, yards, and miles.
units.a3: Temperature converts among °C, °F, and kelvin, including the offset, not just a scale factor.
units.q4: Are these US or imperial gallons?
units.a4: Volume uses US customary cups, fluid ounces, and gallons. Length and mass use the international yard and pound.
units.a5: No. The arithmetic runs in this tab. Closing it discards the numbers.

barcode.q1: Can I generate a barcode here?
barcode.a1: Yes. Code 128, Code 39, and EAN-13 draw in this tab. Download a PNG when it looks right.
barcode.a2: Code 128 holds letters and digits for labels and shipping. EAN-13 is the 13-digit retail product barcode.
barcode.a3: No. Encoding and drawing stay in this tab. Closing it discards the image.
barcode.a4: Phone cameras and USB scanners read these formats when printed with enough size and contrast.
barcode.q5: When should I use a QR code instead?
barcode.a5: Use the QR tool for URLs and longer text. Barcodes are for short IDs and product numbers.

meme.q1: Can I make a meme here?
meme.a1: Yes. Drop a photo, type top and bottom captions, then download a PNG. Nothing is uploaded.
meme.a2: Classic meme style: Impact or a heavy sans, white fill and a black outline.
meme.a3: No. Drawing stays in this tab. Closing it discards the image.
meme.a4: Yes. Paste or drop PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or HEIC when the browser can decode it.
meme.q5: How is this different from watermark?
meme.a5: Watermark is for a logo or copyright mark. This tool is for large top and bottom captions.

text-to-speech.q1: Can I convert text to speech here?
text-to-speech.a1: Yes. Paste text, pick a voice, and press Speak. The browser reads it with voices already on your device.
text-to-speech.a2: No. SpeechSynthesis runs in this tab. Closing it stops playback.
text-to-speech.a3: No. The browser voice engine does not give an audio file, so this tool only plays sound.
text-to-speech.q4: Why is the voice list empty?
text-to-speech.a4: Some browsers fill voices after a moment, or they have none installed. Chrome, Safari, and Edge usually work.
text-to-speech.q5: Does it support Chinese or other languages?
text-to-speech.a5: If your system has that language pack, it appears in the list. The page does not fetch cloud voices.

invoice.q1: Can I generate an invoice PDF here?
invoice.a1: Yes. Fill from/to, line items, tax, and currency, then download a one-page A4 PDF.
invoice.q2: Is this an official tax invoice?
invoice.a2: No. It is a simple PDF you fill in. Not accounting software and not a government tax form.
invoice.a3: No. The page is drawn in this tab and packed into a PDF here. Closing the tab discards it.
invoice.a4: Yes. The PDF is a page image, so it can include any language your browser can draw.
invoice.a5: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY, KRW, VND, and IDR. Amounts use the browser's currency format.

signature.q1: Can I generate a signature here?
signature.a1: Yes. Draw with a mouse or finger, then download a cropped PNG. Nothing is uploaded.
signature.q2: Is this a legally binding e-signature?
signature.a2: No. It is a picture of a drawing. It is not DocuSign and not a qualified electronic signature.
signature.a3: No. The pad runs in this tab. Closing it discards the strokes.
signature.q4: Does the PNG have a transparent background?
signature.a4: Yes. Export crops to the ink and keeps a transparent background for placing on documents.
signature.a5: Yes. Undo removes the last stroke. Clear wipes the pad.

diff.q1: Can I compare two texts here?
diff.a1: Yes. Paste the original on the left and the new version on the right. The result marks added and removed lines.
diff.a2: It is a line-level comparison in this tab. It is not connected to Git and does not open files from a repo.
diff.a3: No. Comparison runs in this tab. Closing it discards both sides.
diff.a4: Yes. Ignore spaces collapses extra whitespace before comparing.
diff.a5: Yes. Copy puts a unified +/− listing on the clipboard.

uuid.q1: Can I generate a UUID here?
uuid.a1: Yes. It makes RFC 4122 version 4 UUIDs with Web Crypto in this tab.
uuid.q2: Are these sequential or based on MAC?
uuid.a2: No. Version 4 is random. There is no v1 time or hardware address.
uuid.a3: No. Random bytes come from Web Crypto locally. Closing the tab discards the list.
uuid.a4: Yes. Uncheck hyphens for a 32-character hex string. Uppercase is optional.
uuid.q5: Can I copy several at once?
uuid.a5: Yes. Copy list puts every UUID on its own line on the clipboard.

regex.q1: Can I test a regular expression here?
regex.a1: Yes. Type a pattern and sample text. Matches are listed in this tab.
regex.a2: No. The tester runs in this tab. Closing it discards the pattern and text.
regex.a3: g, i, m, s, and u. Sticky y is omitted. Invalid patterns show the engine error.
regex.a4: Yes. Fill replace to preview a substitution. $1 and $& work as in JavaScript.
regex.a5: Yes. Text is capped at 20,000 characters and 200 matches so the tab stays responsive.

favicon.q1: Can I make a favicon here?
favicon.a1: Yes. Drop a photo. The tab draws square PNG sizes and packs a .ico.
favicon.a2: No. Decoding and drawing stay in this tab. Closing it discards the image.
favicon.a3: 16, 32, and 48 pixel PNG images inside one favicon.ico file.
favicon.q4: Do you include Apple touch icons?
favicon.a4: The PNG zip has 180, 192, and 512 as well as the classic 16, 32, and 48 sizes.
favicon.q5: Can I keep a transparent background?
favicon.a5: Yes. Uncheck white background. Contain mode then letterboxes on transparency.

audio-cutter.a1: Yes. Drop a file, set start and end, then download a WAV of that slice.
audio-cutter.a2: No. Decoding and cutting stay in this tab. Closing it discards the audio.
audio-cutter.a3: Whatever this browser can decode: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, AAC, FLAC, or WebM. Output is always WAV.
audio-cutter.a4: Yes. Play selection plays from the start mark to the end mark.
audio-cutter.q5: Can I keep the original format?
audio-cutter.a5: No. The cut is written as WAV so the tab does not need an encoder for MP3 or AAC.

timestamp.q1: Can I convert a Unix timestamp here?
timestamp.a1: Yes. Paste seconds, milliseconds, or an ISO date. The tab shows UTC and your local time.
timestamp.q2: How do you tell seconds from milliseconds?
timestamp.a2: About 13 or more digits are milliseconds. Shorter numbers are seconds. ISO dates are parsed as dates.
timestamp.a3: No. Conversion runs in this tab. Closing it discards the input.
timestamp.a4: Now fills the current Unix time in seconds. A live line also shows the current second.
timestamp.a5: Yes. Copy puts seconds, milliseconds, ISO, and the UTC string on the clipboard.

rotate.q1: Can I rotate a photo here?
rotate.a1: Yes. Drop a photo, turn it 90° or any angle, flip it, then download.
rotate.a2: No. Decode, rotate, and export stay in this tab. Closing it discards the file.
rotate.a3: 90° and 180° keep the full photo. Other angles expand the canvas so nothing is clipped.
rotate.a4: Yes. Horizontal and vertical flips combine with the rotation angle.
rotate.a5: JPG, PNG, or WebP. JPG and WebP have a quality slider.

exif.a1: Yes. The tab re-encodes the photo, which drops EXIF, GPS, and similar tags.
exif.a2: No. Decode and export stay in this tab. Closing it discards the file.
exif.a3: Yes. Location tags live in EXIF. The new file is drawn without that block.
exif.a4: No. It writes a new picture without the original metadata tags. It is not a guarantee against every hidden channel.
exif.a5: JPG, PNG, or WebP. The new file comes from a canvas redraw.

audio-joiner.q1: Can I join audio files here?
audio-joiner.a1: Yes. Drop two or more clips, put them in order, then download one WAV.
audio-joiner.a2: No. Decoding and joining stay in this tab. Closing it discards the files.
audio-joiner.a3: Whatever this browser can decode: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, AAC, FLAC, or WebM. Output is always WAV.
audio-joiner.a4: Later clips are resampled to the first clip’s rate before they are joined.
audio-joiner.a5: No. The joined file is WAV so the tab does not need an MP3 encoder.

hex-rgb.q1: Can I convert HEX to RGB here?
hex-rgb.a1: Yes. Paste #hex, rgb(), or hsl(). The tab shows RGB, HSL, and CMYK.
hex-rgb.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab. Closing it discards the color.
hex-rgb.a4: Yes. Copy puts HEX, rgb(), hsl(), and cmyk() on the clipboard.
hex-rgb.a5: The picker is a separate tool. This page is for converting values.

xml-json.q1: Can I convert XML to JSON here?
xml-json.a1: Yes. Paste XML for JSON, or JSON for XML. It runs in this tab.
xml-json.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab. Closing it discards both sides.
xml-json.a3: Attributes become keys prefixed with @. Text nodes use #text when mixed with children.
xml-json.a4: Simple documents do. Namespaces, mixed content, and DTDs are not a full XML suite.
xml-json.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted text on the clipboard.

hash.a1: Yes. MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 run in this tab.
hash.a2: No. Hashing stays in this tab. Closing it discards the input.
hash.a3: Yes. Open file reads it locally and hashes the bytes.
hash.a4: No. MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security. Use them for checksums, not password storage.

yaml-json.q1: Can I convert YAML to JSON here?
yaml-json.a1: Yes. Paste YAML for JSON, or JSON for YAML. It runs in this tab.
yaml-json.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab. Closing it discards both sides.
yaml-json.a3: Maps, lists, scalars, quotes, and simple inline [] {}. Anchors and tags are not a full YAML 1.2 suite.
yaml-json.a4: Simple configs do. Complex YAML (merge keys, custom tags) may not.
yaml-json.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted text on the clipboard.

case.q1: Can I change letter case here?
case.a1: Yes. Upper, lower, title, sentence, camel, Pascal, snake, kebab, and CONSTANT.
case.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab. Closing it discards the text.
case.q3: How does Title Case split words?
case.a3: It splits on spaces, punctuation, and camelCase boundaries.
case.a4: Basic Latin letters convert with toUpperCase/toLowerCase. Word splits keep common Latin letters.
case.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted text on the clipboard.

jwt.q1: Can I decode a JWT here?
jwt.a1: Yes. Paste a token. The tab shows the header and payload as JSON.
jwt.a2: No. Decoding stays in this tab. Closing it discards the token.
jwt.a3: No. This is a decoder only. It does not prove the token is authentic.
jwt.a4: If payload.exp is a Unix second, the tab says whether that time has passed.
jwt.a5: Yes. Copy puts the payload JSON on the clipboard.

screenshot.q1: Can I mark up a screenshot here?
screenshot.a1: Yes. Drop a photo, draw a box or arrow, add a label, then download a PNG.
screenshot.a2: No. Drawing stays in this tab. Closing it discards the file.
screenshot.a3: Rectangles, arrows, and text. Pick a color in the rail.
screenshot.a4: Yes. Undo removes the last mark.
screenshot.a5: A PNG of the photo plus the marks.

percent.q1: Can I calculate a percentage here?
percent.a1: Yes. Enter A and B. The tab shows A% of B, A as a percent of B, B plus A%, and the change from B to A.
percent.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
percent.a3: “What percent” and percent change are blank when the base is zero.
percent.a4: They use ordinary JavaScript numbers and are rounded for display.
percent.a5: Yes. Copy puts all four lines on the clipboard.

random.q1: Can I generate a random number here?
random.a1: Yes. Set min, max, and how many integers you want, then roll.
random.a2: No. Numbers come from crypto.getRandomValues in this tab.
random.a3: Yes. Both min and max can appear.
random.q4: How many numbers can I make?
random.a5: Yes. Copy puts one number per line.

html.a1: Yes. Paste text. Encode turns <>&"' into entities. Decode reverses named and numeric codes.
html.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab.
html.a3: amp, lt, gt, quot, apos, and nbsp. Other names stay as written. Numeric &#…; codes decode.
html.a4: No. This only rewrites characters. It does not execute HTML.
html.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted text on the clipboard.

cron.q1: Can I read a cron expression here?
cron.a1: Yes. Paste five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.
cron.a2: No. Parsing stays in this tab.
cron.a3: No. Only the five numeric fields, *, ranges, lists, and */n steps.
cron.a5: No. It only explains the expression. It does not run jobs.

slug.q1: Can I make a URL slug here?
slug.a1: Yes. Paste a title. The tab lowercases it, drops accents, and joins words with hyphens.
slug.a2: No. The slug is built in this tab.
slug.q3: What happens to Chinese or emoji?
slug.a3: Characters that are not a–z or 0–9 become hyphens and then get trimmed.
slug.a4: It is capped at 80 characters, without a trailing hyphen.
slug.a5: Yes. Copy puts the slug on the clipboard.

portrait-sim.q1: Does this use my camera or upload photos?
portrait-sim.a1: No. Photoreal plates stay on cv.cm. Nothing is uploaded. Snap downloads stay on your device. Your camera is not used.
portrait-sim.q2: Why doesn’t UV change the picture?
portrait-sim.a2: Digital sensors already block UV. A UV filter is nearly clear. It is not a UV lens. ND, polarizer and diffusion are the filters you can see.
portrait-sim.q3: Can I try a phone lens?
portrait-sim.a3: Yes. Choose Phone 26 mm-e. Aperture stays at f/1.8 because a phone iris is fixed.
portrait-sim.q4: Is this studio lighting or a moving key light?
portrait-sim.a4: Scene exposure is white balance on a pre-lit plate. Fill light (white, blacklight, gold) is a gel on the sitter, not a moving key.
portrait-sim.q5: Are the people real, or children?
portrait-sim.a5: They are simulated adult sitters only — photoreal and anime. There are no minors and no uploads of real faces.

age.a1: Yes. Pick a birth date and a date. The tab shows years, months, days, and total days.
age.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
age.a3: Civil months: if the day has not been reached, the previous month is used.
age.a4: February 29 is a real date. The next years count from the civil calendar.
age.a5: Yes. Copy puts a one-line summary on the clipboard.

bmi.a1: Yes. Enter kilograms and centimetres. The tab shows BMI and a WHO band.
bmi.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
bmi.a3: Under 18.5, 18.5–24.9, 25–29.9, and 30+ as used by WHO adult BMI.
bmi.a4: No. It is a simple index. It is not medical advice.
bmi.a5: Yes. Copy puts the BMI and band on the clipboard.

binary.q1: Can I convert text to binary here?
binary.a1: Yes. Text becomes 8-bit UTF-8 groups. Binary can be turned back into text.
binary.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab.
binary.a3: Spaces are ignored when decoding. Encoding puts a space between bytes.
binary.q4: What if the bits are not a multiple of 8?
binary.a4: Decode fails. Each UTF-8 byte needs eight 0/1 digits.
binary.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted text on the clipboard.

tip.q1: Can I calculate a tip here?
tip.a1: Yes. Enter the bill, a percent, and how many people. The tab shows the tip, total, and share.
tip.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
tip.a3: The people count is a whole number of 1 or more. The share is the total divided by that count.
tip.a4: None. It is just a number with two decimal places.
tip.a5: Yes. Copy puts tip, total, and per person on the clipboard.

morse.a1: Yes. Text becomes dots and dashes. Morse can be turned back into letters.
morse.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab.
morse.a3: Letters are spaced. Words use a slash. Unknown Morse returns an error.
morse.a4: International Morse for Latin letters, digits, and a few punctuation marks.
morse.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted text on the clipboard.

roman.q1: Can I convert Roman numerals here?
roman.a1: Yes. Numbers 1 to 3999 become standard subtractive Roman, and valid Roman becomes a number.
roman.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab.
roman.a3: This tab uses the common form IV for 4. Additive IIII is rejected.
roman.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted value on the clipboard.

discount.q1: Can I calculate a discount here?
discount.a1: Yes. Enter the original price and a percent off. The tab shows the sale price and how much you save.
discount.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
discount.a3: Yes. A 120% off price can go negative. That is still just arithmetic.
discount.a4: None. It is just a number with two decimal places.
discount.a5: Yes. Copy puts sale price and savings on the clipboard.

countdown.q1: Can I run a countdown here?
countdown.a1: Yes. Set hours, minutes, and seconds, then start. Pause and reset are in this tab.
countdown.a2: No. The timer runs in this tab. Closing it stops the count.
countdown.q3: Does it keep running in the background?
countdown.a3: Only while this tab stays open. It is not a system alarm.
countdown.q5: Can I change the time while it runs?
countdown.a5: Pause or reset, then edit the fields.

loan.q1: Can I estimate a loan payment here?
loan.a1: Yes. Enter principal, yearly interest percent, and years. The tab shows a fixed monthly payment.
loan.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
loan.a3: A standard amortizing payment: n is months, r is yearly rate / 12.
loan.a4: No. Fees, compounding, and extra payments are not included.
loan.a5: Yes. Copy puts payment, total interest, and total paid on the clipboard.

stopwatch.a1: Yes. Start, pause, and reset a stopwatch in this tab. It shows hours, minutes, seconds, and hundredths.
stopwatch.a2: No. The timer runs in this tab.
stopwatch.q3: Does it keep running in the background?
stopwatch.a3: Only while this tab stays open. Closing the tab stops it. It is not a system clock.
stopwatch.a4: The display is hundredths of a second. It is for elapsed time, not a certified lab timer.
stopwatch.a5: No. This tab only tracks total elapsed time.

compound.q1: Can I calculate compound interest here?
compound.a1: Yes. Enter principal, yearly percent, years, and how often it compounds. The tab shows future value and interest earned.
compound.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
compound.a3: A = P (1 + r/n)^(n t). n is compounds per year. Yearly, quarterly, monthly, and daily are built in.
compound.a4: No. Fees, inflation, and taxes are not included.
compound.a5: None. It is just a number with two decimal places.

vat.q1: Can I calculate VAT or sales tax here?
vat.a1: Yes. Enter an amount and a rate. Exclusive adds tax. Inclusive splits a gross price into net and tax.
vat.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
vat.a3: The rate you enter. This tab does not look up a country rate.
vat.a4: No. It is arithmetic on the numbers you type.
vat.a5: None. It is just a number with two decimal places.

games.q1: Can I play NES games in the browser?
games.a1: Yes. NES through Mega Drive use EmulatorJS from GitHub (fceumm, snes9x, gambatte, mGBA, Genesis Plus GX). Cores are on S3. Flash opens a SWF with Ruffle. Touch controls work on phones.
games.q2: Do you host Super Mario or Contra ROMs?
games.a2: No commercial dumps. Those pages have cheats and walkthroughs; you load a ROM you own. Shiru freeware (Alter Ego, Lawn Mower) starts without a file.
games.a3: Each game page lists Game Genie / Gameshark-style codes. After the ROM boots, paste them in the emulator cheat menu. Codes depend on the dump version.
games.a4: No. A local file is read in this tab and handed to the emulator. Homebrew we may redistribute is fetched from our S3 bucket.
games.q5: Which consoles work on a phone?
games.a5: NES, GB, GBC, and most GBA / Mega Drive titles. SNES is heavier. Flash plays a SWF you choose, with touch treated as the mouse. Landscape plus a Bluetooth pad helps fighters and karts.

reverse.a1: Yes. Paste text and the tab shows it backwards. It also says whether the letters and digits form a palindrome.
reverse.a2: No. The text stays in this tab.
reverse.a3: Yes. Spaces, punctuation, and letter case are ignored. “Race car” counts as a palindrome.
reverse.a4: Graphemes reverse in order. Palindrome uses letters and digits, including CJK characters.
reverse.a5: Yes. Copy puts the reversed text on the clipboard.

url-encode.a1: Yes. Encode uses percent-encoding (encodeURIComponent). Decode turns % sequences back into text.
url-encode.a2: No. Encoding stays in this tab.
url-encode.a3: On decode, + becomes a space, like query strings often do.
url-encode.q4: Is this a full URL parser?
url-encode.a4: No. It encodes or decodes the string you paste. It does not split a URL into parts.
url-encode.a5: A broken % sequence shows an error. Fix the hex pairs and try again.

text-hex.q1: Can I convert text to hex here?
text-hex.a1: Yes. Text becomes UTF-8 bytes as two-digit hex. Hex can convert back to text.
text-hex.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab.
text-hex.a3: Spaces, colons, and 0x prefixes are ignored on decode. Odd-length hex is invalid.
text-hex.a4: UTF-8. Invalid UTF-8 bytes return an error.
text-hex.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted value on the clipboard.

json.a1: Yes. Paste JSON and pretty-print it with indent, or minify it to one line.
json.a2: No. Formatting stays in this tab.
json.q3: What if the JSON is invalid?
json.a3: The tab shows an error. Trailing commas and comments are not JSON.
json.q4: Is this the same as Text and data?
json.a4: Text and data also formats JSON. This page is only pretty-print and minify.
json.a5: Yes. Copy puts the formatted JSON on the clipboard.

base64.a1: Yes. Encode text as Base64, or decode Base64 back to text. UTF-8 is used.
base64.a2: No. Encoding stays in this tab.
base64.a3: This tab is for text. It is not a file host.
base64.a4: Padding must be valid Base64. Broken input shows an error.
base64.a5: Yes. Copy puts the encoded or decoded string on the clipboard.

days.q1: Can I count days between two dates here?
days.a1: Yes. Pick a start date and an end date. The tab shows the signed day count, the absolute days, and whole weeks.
days.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
days.a3: No. These are civil calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD), not clock times.
days.a4: Yes. 28 Feb 2024 to 1 Mar 2024 is 2 days.
days.a5: Yes. Copy puts the day counts on the clipboard.

sort.a1: Yes. Paste one item per line. Sort A→Z, Z→A, or keep the first copy of each line.
sort.a2: No. Sorting stays in this tab.
sort.a3: No. Unique keeps the first time a line appears, in the original order.
sort.a4: Yes. Uppercase letters sort before lowercase in Unicode order.
sort.a5: Yes. Copy puts the lines on the clipboard.

replace.q1: Can I find and replace text here?
replace.a1: Yes. Enter the find string and the replacement. Replace all matches or only the first.
replace.a2: No. Replacement stays in this tab.
replace.a3: No. It is literal text. Use the regex tester if you need patterns.
replace.a4: Nothing changes. An empty find is ignored.
replace.a5: Yes. Copy puts the replaced text on the clipboard.

words.q1: Can I turn a number into words here?
words.a1: Yes. Whole numbers from 0 to 999,999,999,999 become US English words.
words.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab.
words.a3: No. 101 is “one hundred one”, not “one hundred and one”.
words.a4: No. Only whole numbers from 0 up.
words.a5: Yes. Copy puts the words on the clipboard.

add-days.q1: Can I add days to a date here?
add-days.a1: Yes. Pick a date and a whole number of days. Negative numbers go backwards.
add-days.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
add-days.a3: Yes. 28 Feb 2024 plus 1 day is 29 Feb 2024.
add-days.a4: No. These are civil calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD), not clock times.
add-days.a5: Yes. Copy puts the new date on the clipboard.

week.q1: Can I find the week number here?
week.a1: Yes. Pick a date. The tab shows the ISO week, ISO year, and weekday. Monday is day 1.
week.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
week.a3: No. This is ISO-8601. Week 1 is the week with the year’s first Thursday. A late December date can belong to the next year’s week 1.
week.a4: Sunday is weekday 7. The ISO week still starts on Monday.
week.a5: Yes. Copy puts the ISO week label and weekday on the clipboard.

aspect.q1: Can I get an aspect ratio here?
aspect.a1: Yes. Enter width and height in pixels. The tab simplifies them, like 1920×1080 → 16:9.
aspect.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
aspect.a3: No. It only reduces the two numbers. Use Crop if you need to cut a picture.
aspect.a4: Width and height are rounded to whole pixels before simplifying.
aspect.a5: Yes. Copy puts the ratio, such as 16:9, on the clipboard.

workdays.q1: Can I count business days here?
workdays.a1: Yes. Pick two dates. The tab counts Monday through Friday and includes both dates when they are weekdays.
workdays.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
workdays.a3: No. Only Saturdays and Sundays are skipped. Local holidays stay in the count.
workdays.q4: What if both dates are the same?
workdays.a4: A weekday counts as 1. A Saturday or Sunday counts as 0.
workdays.a5: Yes. Copy puts the business-day count and the weekend days on the clipboard.

fraction.q1: Can I simplify a fraction here?
fraction.a1: Yes. Enter a whole numerator and denominator, or switch to a decimal. 4/6 becomes 2/3. 0.75 becomes 3/4.
fraction.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
fraction.a3: No. Results are improper or whole, such as 5/2 or 3, not 2 1/2.
fraction.q4: How close is a repeating decimal?
fraction.a4: Decimals use a continued fraction with a denominator up to 10,000. 0.333333 becomes 1/3.
fraction.a5: Yes. Copy puts the simplified fraction, such as 2/3, on the clipboard.

hourly.q1: Can I turn hourly pay into a yearly salary?
hourly.a1: Yes. Enter an hourly wage, hours per week, and weeks per year. Switch the mode to start from a yearly amount.
hourly.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
hourly.a3: No. This is gross pay only. It does not subtract tax, insurance, or overtime premiums.
hourly.a4: 40 hours a week and 52 weeks a year, which is 2,080 hours. Change either number if your year is shorter.
hourly.a5: Yes. Copy puts hourly, weekly, and yearly gross pay on the clipboard.

margin.q1: Can I calculate a profit margin here?
margin.a1: Yes. Enter a cost and a selling price. The tab shows profit, margin, and markup.
margin.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
margin.q3: What is the difference between margin and markup?
margin.a3: Margin is profit divided by the selling price. Markup is profit divided by the cost. Cost 50 and price 80 is 30 profit, a 37.50% margin, and a 60% markup.
margin.q4: What if the price is below the cost?
margin.a4: Profit, margin, and markup are negative. A zero price has no margin percent. A zero cost has no markup percent.
margin.a5: Yes. Copy puts profit, margin, and markup on the clipboard.

radix.q1: Can I convert binary, decimal, and hex here?
radix.a1: Yes. Type a whole number and two bases from 2 to 36. 255 in base 10 becomes FF in base 16.
radix.a2: No. Conversion stays in this tab.
radix.a3: No. This converts one integer. The binary tool turns letters into groups of 8 bits.
radix.q4: Can I use a 0x prefix or a fraction?
radix.a4: No. Do not type 0x or 0b, and do not type a decimal point. A digit must exist in the source base, so 2 is not a binary digit.
radix.a5: Yes. Copy puts the converted integer on the clipboard. Letters are uppercase.

duration.q1: Can I add hours and minutes here?
duration.a1: Yes. Enter two durations as hours:minutes:seconds. Add them, or subtract the second from the first.
duration.a2: No. The math stays in this tab.
duration.q3: What format do the times use?
duration.a3: Use H:MM:SS, such as 1:30:00. Minutes and seconds must be from 0 to 59.
duration.q4: What if the second time is longer?
duration.a4: Subtracting a longer duration gives a negative result, such as -0:15:00. This is a length of time, not a clock or a time zone.
duration.a5: Yes. Copy puts the duration and the total seconds on the clipboard.

heic-to-jpg.q1: Can I convert HEIC to JPG here?
heic-to-jpg.a1: Yes, in Safari and Chrome. Drop the photo and download a JPG. Nothing is uploaded.
heic-to-jpg.a2: This browser cannot decode HEIC. Use Safari or Chrome. Firefox on Windows often fails.
heic-to-jpg.q3: Does converting make the photo sharper?
heic-to-jpg.a3: No. It only changes the format so more programs can open it. Keep the HEIC if you still edit on iPhone.
heic-to-jpg.q4: Can I convert several HEIC files?
heic-to-jpg.a4: Yes. Drop a batch and download a ZIP of JPGs.
heic-to-jpg.a5: JPG never has transparency. A clear area becomes a solid background.

webp-to-png.q1: Can I convert WebP to PNG?
webp-to-png.a1: Yes. Drop the WebP and download a PNG. Nothing is uploaded.
webp-to-png.a2: Yes, if you export PNG. JPG fills clear pixels, often with black.
webp-to-png.a3: Some forms, editors, and older apps open PNG and reject WebP.
webp-to-png.q4: Can I convert a batch of WebP files?
webp-to-png.a4: Yes. Download one file or a ZIP.
webp-to-png.a5: Usually not. PNG is the compatible copy. Use WebP or JPG when size matters more than a clear edge.

png-to-jpg.q1: Can I convert PNG to JPG?
png-to-jpg.a1: Yes. Drop the PNG and download a JPG. Nothing is uploaded.
png-to-jpg.q2: Why did the background turn black?
png-to-jpg.a2: JPG cannot store transparency. Clear pixels are filled. Use PNG if the edge must stay clear.
png-to-jpg.a3: Photo PNGs usually shrink. A tiny flat graphic may not.
png-to-jpg.a4: Yes. Download one file or a ZIP.
png-to-jpg.a5: No. JPG is a smaller compatible copy, not a sharper one.

jpg-to-png.q1: Can I convert JPG to PNG?
jpg-to-png.a1: Yes. Drop the JPG and download a PNG. Nothing is uploaded.
jpg-to-png.a2: No. JPG has no transparency to recover. The PNG is a solid picture.
jpg-to-png.a3: PNG is lossless. A photo that was JPEG-compressed usually grows.
jpg-to-png.a4: When the next app rejects JPG, or you will edit without another JPEG save.
jpg-to-png.q5: Can I convert a batch of JPGs?
jpg-to-png.a5: Yes. Download one file or a ZIP.

avif-to-jpg.q1: Can I convert AVIF to JPG?
avif-to-jpg.a1: Yes, in a browser that can decode AVIF. Download a JPG. Nothing is uploaded.
avif-to-jpg.q2: Why is the AVIF preview blank?
avif-to-jpg.a2: This browser cannot read AVIF. Use a current Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
avif-to-jpg.q3: Does this make the photo sharper?
avif-to-jpg.a3: No. It only changes the format. Keep the AVIF if you still edit it.
avif-to-jpg.q4: Can I convert several AVIF files?
avif-to-jpg.a4: Yes. Drop a batch and download a ZIP of JPGs.
avif-to-jpg.q5: Will a chat app open the JPG?
avif-to-jpg.a5: JPG is the format older mail, print, and chat apps expect.

png-to-webp.q1: Can I convert PNG to WebP?
png-to-webp.a1: Yes. Drop the PNG and download a WebP. Nothing is uploaded.
png-to-webp.a2: Yes. Unlike JPG, WebP can keep a clear edge.
png-to-webp.q3: Why would I stay with PNG?
png-to-webp.a3: An old form, email client, or editor may reject WebP. Send PNG there.
png-to-webp.a4: Usually for photos and large graphics. Compare the download size before you replace the original.
png-to-webp.q5: Can I convert a batch to WebP?
png-to-webp.a5: Yes. Download one file or a ZIP.

compress-image.q1: Can I compress an image here?
compress-image.a1: Yes. Drop a photo, lower the quality, and download a smaller JPG or WebP. Nothing is uploaded.
compress-image.q2: How do I reduce image size?
compress-image.a2: Use a lower quality, or the 1920, 1280, or 800 preset when the pixel size is the problem. Read the size line before you download.
compress-image.a3: Screen-size photos can take a lower quality and still look fine. If text turns mushy, raise the quality.
compress-image.a4: PNG does not use the quality slider. Export JPG or WebP when you need a smaller file.
compress-image.a5: No. You download a new file. The one on disk stays as it was.

gold.q1: Is a troy ounce the ounce in the unit tool?
gold.a1: No. A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams. The unit tool's oz is the avoirdupois ounce, about 28.35 grams.
gold.a2: The Hong Kong gold tael is 37.429 grams. The market tael is 50 grams. The Taiwan tael is 37.5 grams.
gold.q3: Why is there no gold price?
gold.a3: This page only uses numbers you type. It does not fetch or prefill a price.
gold.q4: What if the price box is empty?
gold.a4: You only see the five weights. Prices appear after you type US dollars per troy ounce.
gold.q5: Can I place an order from this?
gold.a5: No. This is a conversion, not investment advice and not a quote.

silver.q1: Is a troy ounce the ounce in the unit tool?
silver.a1: No. A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams. The unit tool's oz is the avoirdupois ounce, about 28.35 grams.
silver.a2: The Hong Kong gold tael is 37.429 grams. The market tael is 50 grams. The Taiwan tael is 37.5 grams.
silver.q3: Why is there no silver price?
silver.a3: This page only uses numbers you type. It does not fetch or prefill a price.
silver.q4: What if the price box is empty?
silver.a4: You only see the five weights. Prices appear after you type US dollars per troy ounce.
silver.q5: Can I place an order from this?

platinum.q1: Is a troy ounce the ounce in the unit tool?
